{{Quote|On Yn, the Jedi had laid siege to an Imperial stronghold. Tulak Hord broke the siege single-handedly!|translated=1|Khem Val|<ref name="Exultation" />}}
The '''battle of Yn''' was a conflict between the [[Sith Empire/Legends|Sith Empire]] and armies of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and rebels, who faced the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tulak Hord]]. During Hord's campaigns on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|III|355|Yn}}</ref> [[Yn]]<ref name="Exultation" /> and the Jedi-held world of [[Chabosh]],<ref name="Exultation" /> he rejected the [[Sith/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Aloysius Kallig]]'s offer to battle beside him. After Kallig [[Death/Legends|killed]] [[Unidentified general (Tulak Hord)|Hord's right-hand general]], Hord let the other Sith lead his forces in multiple victories.<ref name="TORE" />

When the Jedi attacked a Sith stronghold on Yn<ref name="Exultation" /> around [[5300 BBY]],<ref name="Date" /> Tulak Hord, his [[Sith apprentice/Legends|apprentice]], [[Ortan Cela]], and their [[Dashade/Legends|Dashade]] [[Shadow Killer]]s, [[Khem Val]] and [[Veshikk Urk]],<ref name="The Master's Apprentice" /> led an [[Army/Legends|army]] of [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] warriors to break the Jedi siege, eliminating them and the rebels who opposed the expansion of the Sith Empire.<ref name="Tomb" /> Urk and Val feasted on the [[Living Force/Legends|Force potential]] of their enemies, and Tulak Hord used a [[Tulak Hord's ritual|ritual]] to draw the strength of his enemies to himself in order to gain power and vitality.<ref name="Ritual">{{TORcite|type=codex|The Ritual of Tulak Hord}}</ref> After winning the battle, Hord led his armies to [[Battle of Chabosh (Sith Empire)|take]] Chabosh as well.<ref name="Exultation" />

Khem Val recounted Tulak Hord and his conquest of Yn and Chabosh fondly to the [[Sith Inquisitor]] he served,<ref name="Exultation" /> [[Darth Nox|Kallig's descendant]],<ref name="TORE" /> around [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="TOR date">{{TOR_dates|1}}</ref> occasionally referring to both himself<ref name="Ambient">{{TORcite|type=other|Ambient dialogue with Khem Val as a companion}}</ref> and Hord as the "conqueror of Yn and Chabosh."<ref name="Hoth">{{TORcite|type=conversation|[[Khem Val]]|Trial of the Shadow Killer}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|No, witch! You will be pulled in. I am Khem Val, servant of Tulak Hord, conqueror of Yn and Chabosh. And you are trapped.|Khem Val, to [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Zash's spirit|<ref name="Escape" />}}
The battle of Yn was first mentioned in the entry for Khem Val on [[the Holonet]] portion of the [[BioWare]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]], ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''{{'s}} [https://www.swtor.com official website] in [[2011]].<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|biographies|khem-val|Khem Val}}</ref> If the Sith Inquisitor player character chooses not to help Khem Val in the mission "The Escape,"<ref name="Escape">{{TORcite|type=class|Sith Inquisitor|The Escape|[[Taris/Legends|Taris]]}}</ref> set around 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]]<ref name="TOR date" /> on the world [[Taris/Legends|Taris]], the Dashade would approve of the non-interference and force [[Darth Zash]]'s spirit out of himself and into a [[mind prison]] made by the ancient [[Rakatan]] civilization, proclaiming in triumph that he served Tulak Hord, "conqeuror of Yn and Chabosh."<ref name="Escape" />
